title: Recording, mixing: Woman Is The N****r Of The World by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

John Lennon and Yoko Ono continued recording the Some Time In New York City song ‘Woman Is The N****r Of The World’ on 22 February 1972.

The song had been begun on 16 February. The overdubs recorded during this session included Lennon’s lead vocals.

After the recording was completed the song was mixed, although more mixes would be created on 11 and 18 March – the latter date was when the string parts were overdubbed.

Earlier in the day, Lennon and Ono had been introduced to photographer Bob Gruen, who would become a trusted confidante. Gruen was contracted to photograph the couple for After Dark magazine, and attended the session. Once the recording was complete, he photographed them and the Elephant’s Memory band on 44th Street in Manhattan.

Page last updated: 11 March 2026
